description: List a test case's runSettings records in one lane — one per resolution and feature-flag combination its test spec selects — so a run can name a record it has not run yet. Response shape: { runSettingsList: [{ runSettingsId, resolutionLabel, displayResolution, featureFlags }] }. `resolutionLabel` is the window size as width×height; `displayResolution` is the value the local execute tools take for it, absent when none matches. To run a local record, pass its runSettingsId and displayResolution to muggle-local-execute-test-generation. The list does not mark which record is primary.

runEnvironmentType.description: Lane whose records to list: 'local' (developer localhost) or 'remote' (deployed). A record belongs to one lane.

testCaseId.description: Test case ID whose runSettings records to list

name: muggle-remote-run-settings-list
